verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-aligned text column and an isolated CTA, so it reads left to right like a banner. Its flaws are a large dead gap between the headline and the body copy, a body line that leaves 'and bottles.' orphaned, badges and circle crowding the bottom and left edges, and a small headline for this format. B centres GLACIER on its own axis, out of line with the headline. Its right cluster of badges and CTA is jammed against the right and bottom edges, the badges nearly touch the CTA, and the oversized CTA competes with the headline.
